In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues:

the following: the role of the health system in the prevention of mother-to-child transmission of HIV; the role of the family in the prevention of HIV transmission; the role of women in the prevention of sexual transmission of HIV; and the role of women as a source of support in the treatment of AIDS.

the following issues: (i) the impact of the HIV epidemic on family planning programs and services in developing countries and the need for an appropriate and adequate response to meet the needs of HIV-positive people; (ii) the need for a more integrated approach to the provision of family planning services for HIV-positive people; and (iii) the need for more research to improve our understanding of the impact of the epidemic on women, men, and children.
